about: Every piece of the Grand Opening card (13b-TARGET-grand-opening-original-2172px.png, 2172 x 724), with its box in 13b pixels [x0, y0, x1, y1], its kind (native: Roblox shapes; text: real text from Strings; image: an uploaded picture; flipbook: a sheet stepped by ImageRectOffset; procedural: drawn by code at runtime), its planned source (cut: 13b's own pixels with a mask; regen: GPT Image 2.5 with 13b plus the in-game references; render: from the in-game model or effect; draw: a script), its reveal step (SHOP_LIVELY_PROMPT section 4) and its idle loop. Boxes are measured on a 50 px grid (step 1) and refined from the masks in step 3. The rebuild check and the animatic read this file.
